name: POST /api/leadflow/coverage/opening-validation - the 8:45 checklist
description:
Records the opening validation against the day's launch huddle.

THE MANAGER'S CONFIRMATION IS REQUIRED AND SEPARATE from the checks. A checklist that records itself as confirmed is a form nobody read: the whole point is that a NAMED person looked at the queue and said it was clear, and a boolean the system sets on their behalf records the opposite of what it claims.

A FAILING RESULT IS STILL RECORDED. A validation that refuses to save a bad result is a validation nobody runs on a bad morning, which is the only morning it matters. QA: measured live — the refusal and the recorded pass.

testCases.name: The checklist is recorded against the day's huddle with its failures named
A checklist that confirms itself is REFUSED
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: manager_confirmed must be true - the opening validation records that a named person looked at the queue, and a checklist that confirms itself records the opposite of what it claims
errorCases.when: the manager confirmation is absent or false.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
